type-system.twistDescription: Font size scale shift (h1 x1.3 to 7.020rem), heading weight maximization (h1=800, h2=700, h3=600), label letter-spacing 0.08em added. Bricolage Grotesque + Inter via Google Fonts CDN.

motion-system.twistDescription: Duration scaling x0.5 (90-180ms range), all non-linear easings replaced with linear. Step-reveal keyframe and stepCount tokens added.

grid-system.twistDescription: Gap value scaling x1.4 across all grid definitions and responsive breakpoints.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Global x1.35 scale factor on all px values. Added --space-flat-block (160px) for color-block section separators.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Removed all transform lifts, replaced cubic-bezier with linear, capped durations at 100ms, scoped to background-color + color only. Added focus/active/disabled states.

nav-system.twistDescription: backgroundPill enabled (false -> true), hover duration 0.4s -> 0.1s linear.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Full Flat Design 2.0 concept override: zero elevation, color-blocking, geometric CSS shape vocabulary, typographic weight contrast, hard-edge section transitions.
